description: This file defines constants, types, static model catalog, and functions for discovering and building model definitions related to Vercel AI Gateway integration.

methods.name: toPerMillionCost
methods.description: Converts a cost value (number or string) to a per-million scale number, handling invalid or negative inputs.

methods.name: normalizeCost
methods.description: Normalizes pricing data into a ModelDefinitionConfig cost object with per-million scale values.

methods.name: buildStaticModelDefinition
methods.description: Builds a ModelDefinitionConfig object from a static model catalog entry.

methods.name: getStaticFallbackModel
methods.description: Retrieves a static fallback model definition by ID from the catalog.

methods.name: buildDiscoveredModelDefinition
methods.description: Builds a model definition from a discovered model shape, applying defaults and normalization.

methods.name: getStaticVercelAiGatewayModelCatalog
methods.description: Returns the static catalog of predefined Vercel AI Gateway models.

methods.name: discoverVercelAiGatewayModels
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches available models from the Vercel AI Gateway API or returns static catalog in test environments.
